Appears to be a sausage alongside cooked potatoes and mixed vegetables, with a red tomato-based sauce and possibly a little melted cheese. Some ingredients are obscured by sauce.

### 2 — Vessel

### 3 — Items
Visible or likely identifiable: sausage, potato chunks, green vegetables (broccoli/Brussels sprouts), carrot pieces, tomato-based sauce, and a small amount of melted cheese. No separate quantity of oil is clearly discernible.

### 8 — Sanity check
